name: Shipbuilding

pages.title: The Shipwright's Workbench
pages.text: Before one can begin the arduous Process of Shipbuilding, we must gather our tools. The most essential is the Dockyard, a puissant Workbench which provides all the Neccessaries for the Task. Once constructed, place it near the Body of Water into which you plan to launch.

pages: All Ships, of any Design, require the same Elements, albeit in differing Measure. A Hull is wrought from Timber like a Boat, but grander in Scale. Sails need stout Masts, woolen Cloth or Canvas to catch the Wind, and fortified Ropes for Rigging. Further Ropes secure the Vessel's Fittings and Cargo.$(br)    Of Timber, I have already spoken. Gather a great Heap of it, for Needs may exceed Estimation.  Wood Type matters not, and may be chosen by Taste or Opportunity.$(br)   Once you have Gathered the needed Materials, take them to your Dockyard and select a Plan for your vessel. Once started, Construction may take significant Time.
